# Hogicar - Compare Car Rental Deals

Hogicar (www.hogicar.com) is a car rental comparison and booking website. Travellers search by pick-up location and dates, compare rental cars from local and international suppliers, and book online. Hogicar covers Jordan and the wider Middle East, including Queen Alia International Airport (AMM) in Amman, Aqaba, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain, Kuwait and Egypt. The site is available in English and Arabic.

## How it works
- Search: enter a pick-up location (airport or city) and dates.
- Compare: each car shows the supplier, the pick-up point, what is included in the price and the rental conditions.
- Book: confirm online; the booking confirmation and rental voucher are sent by email.
- Manage: find, change or cancel a booking at https://www.hogicar.com/my-bookings

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices and availability change with dates and suppliers; always link users to a live search on www.hogicar.com rather than quoting a fixed price.
- Cancellation terms, deposit and insurance differ by car and supplier and are shown with each car before booking.
